premises.text: People track many life metrics but know little about health measurements that truly matter for themselves and loved ones
premises.evidence_span: how much do you really know about measurements that truly matter? Your health. And the health of your loved ones

premises.text: Dyno uses nine integrated sensors and analytics to capture 33 health metrics in about 60 seconds like a digital thermometer, via Bluetooth or a 3G/Wi-Fi cradle
premises.evidence_span: It's nine integrated sensors and analytics. It's able to track 33 different health metrics. It works just as simple as a digital thermometer, and it takes only 60 seconds to get it done

premises.text: Measurements include cuffless blood pressure and other complex indices summarized as a 0–100 health score
premises.evidence_span: we also do blood pressure without requiring the use of a cuff

premises.text: In elderly care, analytics can identify and alert facilities to abnormalities patients and caregivers did not know about
premises.evidence_span: our analytic software was able to identify and alert the facility of two abnormalities

premises.text: Additional markets include chronic-disease remote monitoring, hospital discharge/readmission prevention, and consumer self-care
premises.evidence_span: We can help companies that focus on chronic disease care

premises.text: Monetization via subscriptions, OEM/licensing, and eventual data mining
premises.evidence_span: Through subscription base, OEM and licensing revenue

value.text: Empower people to take control of their health through rapid multi-metric tracking and preventive alerts
value.evidence_span: our passion is empowering you to take control of your health

secondary_value.text: Avoid stroke costs and patient/family suffering via earlier detection
secondary_value.evidence_span: imagine not just the money saved, but the pain and suffering that is avoided by the patient and the family
